constraints: Information reflects where the command is executed: called from a remote 4D it describes only that workstation; called in code running on the server it describes the server.

On Windows, the cpuUsage/networkInputThroughput/networkOutputThroughput counters require having been previously initialized by an earlier call to Application info (e.g. from the On Startup database method) before they report real values.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the current application instance's activity and network configuration (CPU/network usage, server listening state, ports, UI mode flags, uptime, etc.), scoped to wherever the call executes.
